shortBio: I own North Star Architecture at Verizon Value — the enterprise middle tier behind seven national brands. Catalog, order-to-cash, supply chain, billing, and financial close on one platform: 9.9 million accounts, 728 million records, promotions in 48 hours, an eight-figure book of work. about: Innovative, results-oriented, data-driven technology leader who turns a fragmented commercial estate into one platform that sells faster, bills accurately, and closes clean.

As Director of Engineering at Verizon Value, I own North Star Architecture — the OSS/BSS middle tier behind seven national wireless brands. Product catalog, order-to-cash (O2C), supply chain, billing, payments, and the financial close run as one system. I operate with full accountability for the technology portfolio and cost-to-serve, bridging finance, brand, and engineering so sell, promise, ship, bill, and book stay one conversation.

Speed to revenue: promotion deployment collapsed from five to six weeks to 48 hours, and activation from 38 seconds to 12. One digital catalog is the system of record for 5,000+ offers, 500+ rules, and 300+ promotions, with 1,800+ mappings into fulfill, bill, and campaign.

Straight-through processing: 9.9 million accounts and 728 million records moved with zero downtime and no forced password resets, retiring 114 batch jobs and 12,000 daily manual corrections and cutting data staleness from 24 hours to under 30 minutes. The platform carries 18.5 million live transactions and 309 million API calls for 10,000+ concurrent users at 99.45% order flow-through, with 250+ APIs orchestrated behind one customer experience across seven commercial channels.

Revenue assurance: five billing engines collapsed into one Oracle BRM and three tax engines into one. PCI DSS Level 1 with ~9M cards tokenized. A daily order–bill–ledger reconciliation keeps the close audit-ready.

The operating model: an eight-figure annual book of work with monthly actuals and priced SOWs, a multi-hundred-person matrix organization with component-level ownership across global vendors, offshore, and onshore teams, and a named owner on every service. I pioneered an AI-native operating model — generative and agentic AI across the SDLC — AI-led feature development, automated BRD generation, AI-led code reviews under architectural governance, and defect triage with auto-remediation — under the same PCI/PII bar as the human org.

The integration job is the one SAP names BTP: TM Forum Open APIs and an enterprise gateway in front of payments, VAS, device OEMs, retail POS, and partner subscriptions — inbound and outbound to SAP ERP, with S/4HANA on the 2027 roadmap. Same job I have done for 20 years on Oracle SOA and APIs. Different adapters.
I write on AI-native engineering at Engineering Insights (anubhaws.sg-host.com).
